arxiv-1908-03679.title: Distance Map Loss Penalty Term for Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-1908-03679.creator: Francesco Calivá ∗1, Claudia Iriondo ∗1,2, Alejandro Morales Martinez 1,2, Sharmila Majumdar 1, Valentina Pedoia 1
arxiv-1908-03679.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks for semantic segmentation suffer from low performance at object boundaries. In medical imaging, accurate representation of tissue surfaces and volumes is important for tracking of disease biomarkers such as tissue morphology and shape features. In this work, we propose a novel distance map derived loss penalty term for semantic segmentation.

arxiv-2107-12770.title: Comparing Prophet and Deep Learning to ARIMA in Forecasting Wholesale Food Prices
arxiv-2107-12770.creator: Lorenzo Menculini, Andrea Marini, Massimiliano Proietti, Alberto Garinei, Alessio Bozza, Cecilia Moretti, Marcello Marconi
arxiv-2107-12770.description: Abstract Setting sale prices correctly is of great importance for firms, and the study and forecast of prices time series is therefore a relevant topic not only from a data science perspective but also from an economic and applicative one.

arxiv-2109-00696.title: Observation of the Quantum Boomerang Effect
arxiv-2109-00696.creator: Roshan Sajjad, Jeremy L. Tanlimco, Hector Mas, Alec Cao, Eber Nolasco-Martinez, Ethan Q. Simmons, Flávio L. N. Santos, Patrizia Vignolo, Tommaso Macrì, David M. Weld
arxiv-2109-00696.description: Abstract A particle in an Anderson-localized system, if launched in any direction, should on average return to its starting point and stay there. Despite the central role played by Anderson localization in the modern understanding of condensed matter, this “quantum boomerang” effect, an essential feature of the localized state, was only recently theoretically predicted.

arxiv-2111-12472.title: COVID-19 vaccination certificates in the Darkweb
arxiv-2111-12472.creator: Dimitrios Georgoulias, Jens Myrup Pedersen, Morten Falch, Emmanouil Vasilomanolakis
arxiv-2111-12472.description: Abstract COVID-19 vaccines have been rolled out in many countries and with them a number of vaccination certificates. For instance, the EU is utilizing a digital certificate in the form of a QR-code that is digitally signed and can be easily validated throughout all EU countries.

arxiv-2201-00260.title: A time-dependent switching mean-field game on networks motivated by optimal visiting problems Thanks: This work was partially supported by MUR-PRIN2020 Project (No. 2020JLWP23) “Integrated mathematical approaches to socio-epidemiological dynamics”
arxiv-2201-00260.creator: Fabio Bagagiolo, Luciano Marzufero
arxiv-2201-00260.description: Abstract . Motivated by an optimal visiting problem, we study a switching mean-field game on a network, where both a decisional and a switching time-variable are at disposal of the agents for what concerns, respectively, the instant to decide and the instant to perform the switch.

arxiv-2211-10301.title: A Simpler Proof of Frank and Lieb’s Sharp Inequality on the Heisenberg Group
arxiv-2211-10301.creator: Fengbo Hang, Xiaodong Wang
arxiv-2211-10301.description: Abstract . We give a simpler proof of the sharp Frank-Lieb inequality on the Heisenberg group ℍ m \mathbb{H}^{m} . The proof bypasses the sophisticated argument for existence of a minimizer and is based on the study of the 2nd variation of subcritical functionals using their fundamental techniques. 1.

arxiv-2405-09184.creator: S. Sazonov, R. Burenin, E. Filippova, R. Krivonos, V. Arefiev, K. Borisov, M. Buntov, C.-T. Chen, S. Ehlert, S. Garanin, M. Garin, S. Grigorovich, I. Lapshov, V. Levin, A. Lutovinov, I. Mereminskiy, S. Molkov, M. Pavlinsky, B. D. Ramsey, A. Semena, N. Semena, A. Shtykovsky, R. Sunyaev, A. Tkachenko,
arxiv-2405-09184.description: Abstract We present an updated catalog of sources detected by the Mikhail Pavlinsky ART-XC telescope aboard the Spektrum-Roentgen-Gamma (SRG) observatory during its all-sky survey. It is based on the data of the first four and the partially completed fifth scans of the sky (ARTSS1-5). The catalog comprises 1545 sources detected in the 4–12 keV energy band.

arxiv-2412-17345.title: On the Power and Limitations of Examples for Description Logic Concepts
arxiv-2412-17345.creator: Balder ten Cate, Raoul Koudijs, Ana Ozaki
arxiv-2412-17345.description: Abstract Labeled examples (i.e., positive and negative examples) are an attractive medium for communicating complex concepts. They are useful for deriving concept expressions (such as in concept learning, interactive concept specification, and concept refinement) as well as for illustrating concept expressions to a user or domain expert. We investigate the power of labeled examples for describing description-logic concepts.

arxiv-2602-21446.title: ConformalHDC: Uncertainty-Aware Hyperdimensional Computing with Application to Neural Decoding
arxiv-2602-21446.creator: Ziyi LiangHamed Poursiami, Zhishun Yang, Keiland Cooper Akhilesh JaiswalMaryam Parsa, Norbert Fortin Babak Shahbaba
arxiv-2602-21446.description: Abstract Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) offers a computationally efficient paradigm for neuromorphic learning. Yet, it lacks rigorous uncertainty quantification, leading to open decision boundaries and, consequently, vulnerability to outliers, adversarial perturbations, and out-of-distribution inputs. To address these limitations, we introduce ConformalHDC, a unified framework that combines the statistical guarantees of conformal prediction with the computational efficiency of HDC.

The corona obsidionalis was formed of grass and flowers plucked on the spot and given to the general who conquered a city. The corona civica, made of oak leaves with acorns, was bestowed on the soldier who in battle saved the life of a Roman citizen.

pmc-10615146.description: PurposeTo evaluate the immune regulatory effect of human cord blood myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) in experimental autoimmune uveitis (EAU) models.MethodsMDSCs (1 × 106) or PBS were injected into established C57BL/6 EAU mice via the subconjunctival route on days 0 and 7. pmc-11538420.title: Machine learning models for river flow forecasting in small catchments
pmc-11538420.creator: Marco Luppichini, Giada Vailati, Lorenzo Fontana, Monica Bini
pmc-11538420.description: In consideration of ongoing climate changes, it has been necessary to provide new tools capable of mitigating hydrogeological risks. These effects will be more marked in small catchments, where the geological and environmental contexts do not require long warning times to implement risk mitigation measures.

pmc-12431001.title: ACD-DETR: Adaptive Cross-Scale Detection Transformer for Small Object Detection in UAV Imagery
pmc-12431001.creator: Yang Tong, Hui Ye, Jishen Yang, Xiulong Yang, Tianxian Zhang
pmc-12431001.description: Small object detection in UAV imagery remains challenging due to complex aerial perspectives and the presence of dense, small targets with blurred boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose ACD-DETR, an adaptive end-to-end Transformer detector tailored for UAV-based small object detection.

pmc-12703108.title: Trapeziectomy Versus Carpometacarpal Arthroplasty for Basilar Thumb Arthritis: A Narrative Review of Comparative Outcomes
pmc-12703108.creator: Kavyansh Bhan, Dhruvi Chande, Nirav Valand, Janani Suresh, Shradha Prakash, Satyanarayana Pidikiti
pmc-12703108.description: Basilar thumb arthritis or thumb carpometacarpal (CMC) joint osteoarthritis is a common degenerative condition causing pain, weakness, and functional limitation, particularly among older populations and postmenopausal women. Surgical intervention is often required for advanced disease, with trapeziectomy and prosthetic arthroplasty being the two main approaches.

pmc-12733284.title: Catalytic Effect of Amyloid-β on Native Tau Aggregation at Physiologically Relevant Concentrations
pmc-12733284.creator: Rakhi Chowdhury, Apu Chandra Das, Ruan van Deventer, Luda S Shlyakhtenko, Yuri L Lyubchenko, Jianrong Xu
pmc-12733284.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is characterized by the accumulation and aggregation of tau and amyloid-β (Aβ). The pathophysiology and progression of AD are facilitated by the neurotoxic effects of these aggregated proteins, resulting in neurodegeneration and memory loss. In this context, the interaction between tau and Aβ42 is considered, but the mechanism underlying their pathogenic interplay remains unclear.

pmc-13249632.creator: Andrew R Gamble, Christopher Needs, Christopher G Maher, Marnee J McKay, David B Anderson, Joshua M Hutton, Tarcisio F de Campos, Nadine E Foster, David Martens, Danielle M Coombs, Gustavo C Machado, Christopher S Han, Joshua R Zadro
pmc-13249632.description: ObjectivesEstablish the feasibility of delivering and evaluating stratified care integrated with telehealth (‘Rapid Stratified Telehealth’) to reduce waiting times for people with low back pain seeking care at Australian public hospitals.MethodsWe conducted a single-blinded, single site, 2:1 ratio, two-arm parallel feasibility and pilot randomised controlled trial (RCT) with nested qualitative interviews.

pmc-13525824.creator: Mahtab Ordoei, Nasrin Behniafard, Nasim Namiranian, Samira Asadollahi, Saeede Jam-Ashkezari, Roghaye Razavi
pmc-13525824.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:T1DM is an autoimmune and chronic metabolic disorder characterized by the destruction of pancreatic beta cells. The Bacillus Calmette--Guérin (BCG) vaccine, originally used for tuberculosis prevention, has shown potential in modulating the immune response and improving beta-cell function.

pmc-13569442.title: Atypical cytokine profiles in people on the autism spectrum: a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis including 54 cytokines
pmc-13569442.creator: Theresia Volk, Steve Lukito, Joaquim Radua, Hella Luksch, Veit Roessner, Nicole Beyer
pmc-13569442.description: Atypical peripheral blood cytokine concentrations have been shown in autism, but no clear pattern has been observed. This systematic review and meta-analysis summarised current state of findings, expanded the range of cytokines, accounted for study risk of bias, and examined relations between cytokines and autism traits.
